caption: The drawing features a collection of small mechanical objects arranged horizontally on a plain, off-white background. On the left side, there are six metal parts, including rings and hooked or bent pieces, each depicted in a dark, metallic gray color. In the center of the drawing is a round, shallow dish with a raised circular section in the middle; the dish is colored green with some shaded highlights indicating depth, and the raised center is gray. To the right of the dish is a set of metallic dividers or calipers, drawn in a similar dark gray tone, with two straight legs joined at the top by a circular hinge. The objects are spaced out with no overlapping, and there is a small line of typed text "GEO. V. WEZOLLERS" below the rightmost object. The background is unadorned, with no additional markings or designs.
title: Shaker Scales
